name: slice
description: Build a unit of work through a multi-agent cycle: spec, implement, review (with a few targeted mutants on risky code), one rework round, final review, land, file follow-ups, report to the ticket. A full mutation-testing QA pass runs only on request. Tiered across models so judgement and implementation are done by different ones; each role takes a short alias or a full model id, selectable per invocation or per project, with the resolved model probed before the run rather than assumed.
